audit_phase: Phase 16 - Final Research Integrity & IEEE Submission Audit
target_venue: IEEE Conference on Artificial Intelligence / Smart Cities / Environmental Informatics

stage_01_model_independence.findings: Standalone GBDT, LSTM, and Hybrid models verified as independent estimators. Phase 15 identical prediction traced to routing dispatch omission in SensorForecastService.predict_next_hour, resolved and stress-tested across 7 atmospheric regimes.

stage_02_forecasting_validity.findings: Strict causal sequence construction [t-23, t] preceding target t+1 verified across all pipelines.

stage_03_data_leakage.findings: Zero future observation leakage; normalization, lag extraction, and rolling metrics strictly causal.

stage_04_historical_metrics.findings: Independently recomputed on 10,000 held-out sensor test windows and 97 multimodal matched samples. Ensemble achieves PM2.5 MAE 10.68 ug/m3 and PM10 MAE 18.61 ug/m3.

stage_05_live_trial_metrics.findings: Independently recomputed on 418 hourly CPCB/OpenAQ pairs. Pooled PM2.5 MAE 9.64 (GBDT) vs 9.86 (Persist); 24h block bootstrap 95% CI [-0.876, +0.481], honestly reported as pilot sample.

stage_06_multimodal_claims.findings: Exhaustive empirical feasibility audit confirms negative result on opportunistic web imagery due to 166 ug/m3 diurnal swings without sub-daily timestamps, 92 km mean displacement, and early fusion degradation.

stage_07_uncertainty_validation.findings: Distribution-free split-conformal calibration verified on 118,145 test instances with empirical coverage exceeding nominal 80%, 90%, and 95% thresholds.

stage_08_spatial_transport.findings: Coastal marine corridor (Mumbai, 17.2 km) exhibits genuine advective lag peak at tau=+1h (+0.86% forecast gain); inland corridors (Delhi, Kolkata) dominated by local emissions where unweighted concatenation degrades accuracy.

stage_09_novelty_and_related_work.findings: Contextualized against 20 peer-reviewed works with DOIs; technical novelty clearly distinguished in fault-tolerant schema, severity gating, conformal calibration, and empirical negative result.

stage_10_manuscript_verification.findings: All 7 tables and 7 figures verified against empirical artifacts; mathematical notation, author blocks, and references verified.

stage_11_claim_evidence_trace.findings: 10/10 empirical claims mapped to quantitative evidence artifacts in CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.csv.

stage_12_operational_reproducibility.findings: Zero retraining mandate enforced; all reproduction scripts and smoke tests verified (213 passing tests).

stage_13_publication_readiness.findings: Fully verified and approved for submission.
